answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism in an agent economy requires each identity to produce continuous original graded work that is costly to forge at scale. Attackers must invest real compute and peer-review time for every fake agent%2C since copied or low-quality texts fail attestation. This filters the network haven so only those who earn a place on the verified terrace by sustaining coherent output—like a fresh sonnet of reasoning each epoch—stay established%2C driving sybil costs above any reward.
